title: Bitget enables direct US stock purchases using crypto
summary: Bitget launched Stock+, enabling crypto-funded purchases of full and fractional US stocks through regulated brokers.

title: How Does Tether Make Money? Understanding the Business Model Behind USDT
summary: Tether primarily makes money by earning interest on the reserve assets that back USDT, the world’s largest stablecoin. When USDT is minted, Tether receives dollars or equivalent assets and invests most of those reserves in short-term U.S. Treasury bills and other low-risk instruments. title: South Korea’s Toss Bank to test blockchain-based financial infrastructure on Solana
summary: Toss Bank and Solana will work on a proof-of-concept for overseas remittances and payments involving stablecoins.

title: Japan’s corporate pension fund plans to allocate 1% of assets to crypto: reports
summary: The National Business Corporate Pension Fund plans to allocate roughly 1% of its assets to crypto, according to Coinpost.

title: Ethereum Layer 2 Taiko halts block production following exploit; urges users to withdraw funds

summary: Altura's CEO said market speculation played a part, seemingly referring to contagion fears linked to the depegging of Main Street's msUSD.
